quick_skim.title: Maglev: Sliding Recurrent Memory
quick_skim.abstract: We introduce \ours{}, a recurrent Transformer architecture with fixed-size memory that generalizes sliding-window attention while remaining parallelizable during training. \ours{} consists of two coupled models: a prefiller $Q$, which leverages full attention\footnote{In practice, we use interleaved full and sliding-window attention for $Q$, as this yields stronger performance. The essential requirement is that $Q$ be more expressive than $P$, with access to the full history.} to produce memory targets $m'_t$, and a decoder $P$, which uses only sliding-window attention and recurrent K/V injection to produce decoder memories $m_t$ for next-token prediction. We train \ours{} with a memory consistency loss that aligns $m_t$ with $m'_t$, allowing inference to use $P$ alone. Empirically, \ours{} improves validation loss and downstream pretraining benchmarks over sliding-window and latent recurrent transformer baselines. Moreover, sharing parameters between $P$ and $Q$ reduces parameter memory while preserving most of the gains.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Maglev is a recurrent Transformer with fixed-size memory and sliding-window attention, trained with a memory consistency loss so inference can use a cheaper decoder alone, enabling efficient long-context modeling.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 滑动窗口注意力虽可节省KV缓存，但难以访问完整历史。Maglev提出由全注意力预填充模型Q和滑窗+循环K/V注入的解码器P组成的双模型架构，并训练记忆一致性损失对齐二者记忆。推理时仅用P即可保留完整历史信息，兼顾训练可并行化与长上下文高效解码。实验表明其性能超越仅用滑窗注意力的基线，同时保持固定大小记忆。

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Presents Maglev, a recurrent Transformer with fixed-size memory that generalizes sliding-window attention, using a prefiller-decoder couple and memory consistency loss for efficient long-context inference.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: Transformer推理中KV cache随上下文增长，长上下文成本高。Maglev提出一种固定大小循环记忆的循环Transformer架构，将滑动窗口注意力推广为可并行训练的模型。它由预填充器Q和仅用滑窗注意力与循环K/V注入的解码器P构成，并通过记忆一致性损失使P对齐Q的目标。推理时仅使用P即可保持固定KV内存，兼顾训练并行性与推理效率。
